item.title: Qmd - Local Knowledge Base Search
item.description:
Qmd - Local Knowledge Base Search

Hermes documentation for Qmd, a local hybrid search engine for notes, documents, and transcripts. Covers installation, collection indexing, keyword and semantic search, and MCP integration.

item.title: Apache Maka - Local AI Agent Workspace
item.description:
Apache Maka - Local AI Agent Workspace

An Apache Incubator local-first workspace for AI agents. It records model messages, tool calls, permission decisions, and termination events in an append-only log for auditable agent runs.

item.title: calich - Self-Hosted CalDAV Calendar
item.description:
calich - Self-Hosted CalDAV Calendar

A self-hosted, Google Calendar alternative with CalDAV support. It provides a web calendar and stores its SQLite database and attachments locally in a Docker-deployable service.

item.description:
qmd - Local Document Search Engine

A local command-line search engine for documents, knowledge bases, and meeting notes. It indexes personal content locally and supports current retrieval approaches.

item.title: Hermes Desktop - Desktop Companion
item.description:
Hermes Desktop - Desktop Companion

A community-maintained desktop companion for Hermes Agent, with a graphical interface for agent conversations, provider configuration, and local or remote Hermes installations. It also includes an installer and support for connecting to Docker-backed Hermes deployments over SSH.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Securo - Self-hosted Personal Finance Manager
item.description:
Securo - Self-hosted Personal Finance Manager

Open-source, privacy-first personal finance manager with multi-account tracking, running balances, transaction management, cash-flow views, and imports for OFX, QIF, CAMT, and CSV. Designed for self-hosting and licensed under AGPL-3.0.
item.content:encoded:
Securo - Self-hosted Personal Finance Manager

Open-source, privacy-first personal finance manager with multi-account tracking, running balances, transaction management, cash-flow views, and imports for OFX, QIF, CAMT, and CSV. Designed for self-hosting and licensed under AGPL-3.0.

item.title: JumpKey - Keyboard-driven Service Startpage
item.description:
JumpKey - Keyboard-driven Service Startpage

A minimalist, keyboard-driven local-first PWA startpage for organizing and launching services. Supports configurable service links, icons, workspaces, standalone serving, automatic backups, and integration behind Caddy or other reverse proxies.
item.content:encoded:

item.description:

Desktop workspace for delegating projects to AI models, connecting business data sources, creating shareable artifacts, and scheduling recurring agent tasks. Supports model routing and multiple agent harnesses.

item.title: OpenMessage - Local-First Messaging Workspace
item.description:
OpenMessage - Local-First Messaging Workspace

Open-source, local-first inbox for Google Messages, WhatsApp, and Signal on macOS or a local web UI. Includes an MCP server so compatible agents can query and send messages through the local runtime.
item.content:encoded:
OpenMessage - Local-First Messaging Workspace

Open-source, local-first inbox for Google Messages, WhatsApp, and Signal on macOS or a local web UI. Includes an MCP server so compatible agents can query and send messages through the local runtime.
